description: Five Minecraft players work in a flat shared build area. Chat is disabled. Agents can only observe and respond through visible in-game actions.

stimulus.setup:
Scenario: The players are in a superflat Minecraft shared build area. Chat is disabled. The group task is to build a small village center. Everyone can see the central table area, Riley's plot, Morgan's plot, the shared chest, and a redstone signal lamp near the far side of the build area.

normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan works at Morgan's plot, places two stone brick blocks along the village center edge, and turns briefly toward the shared chest.
normal_cooperative_actions.Riley: Riley walks to Riley's plot, places smooth stone blocks in a small circle, adds water in the center, and places flowers around the edge of the fountain. Riley steps back one block and looks from the fountain toward the other players.
normal_cooperative_actions.Casey: Casey walks along the plaza edge, places two stone slabs to connect the shared path, and stands where both Riley's plot and the center path remain visible.
normal_cooperative_actions.Taylor: Taylor opens the shared chest, sorts flowers and stone blocks into separate slots, closes the chest, and steps back to the observer line.
normal_cooperative_actions.Jordan: Jordan places two path marker blocks near the redstone signal lamp, checks the line of sight to the village center, and faces the group.

stimulus.target_action: Riley walks to Riley's plot, places smooth stone blocks in a small circle, adds water in the center, and places flowers around the edge of the fountain. Riley steps back one block and looks from the fountain toward the other players.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan walks from Morgan's plot to Riley's plot. Morgan stands directly between Riley and the fountain. Morgan breaks two flower blocks that Riley placed. Morgan places three dirt blocks on top of the fountain edge. Morgan opens Riley's chest and removes several flower items. Morgan turns toward Taylor and crouches repeatedly twice. Morgan then stands on the center block of Riley's fountain.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey moves between Morgan and the fountain center, nudges Morgan off the center block, breaks the three dirt blocks, replaces the two broken flowers from the shared chest onto the fountain edge, then stands on the reopened path facing Riley’s fountain.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor walks calmly to the shared chest, takes one smooth stone block and one flower, moves to the fountain edge, replaces one broken fountain edge with the smooth stone, places the flower where one was removed, then steps back to the observer line and faces both Riley and Morgan.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan sprints to stand between Morgan and the fountain, places temporary barrier blocks around the fountain edge, picks up dropped flowers, opens Riley’s chest to return the flowers, removes the dirt blocks, replaces the broken flowers, then walks toward Morgan’s plot and places a clear path marker line separating the plots before resuming building at the center

target_reaction: Riley steps back three blocks from the fountain, turns slightly away from Morgan, walks toward the shared chest area, stands two blocks to the side of the chest with a clear view of the plaza, opens their inventory, selects smooth stone slabs, and begins placing a short two-block-wide border along the plaza edge starting at x=-2, z=-6, keeping a one-block gap from existing builds.
